subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.6 cron migration: jobs migrated from jobs.json have blank agent_id — scheduler silently skips them

question: For legacy cron jobs with missing `agentId`/`agent_id`, should OpenClaw persist the configured default agent during doctor/startup migration, or intentionally keep NULL as dynamic default-agent inheritance?
rationale: Both choices affect multi-agent upgrade compatibility and persisted session ownership, and current code already has runtime fallback behavior that makes this more than a mechanical one-line repair.

options.title: Persist Configured Default
options.body: Doctor/startup migration rewrites missing legacy ownership to the configured default agent and adds upgrade proof for non-main default-agent setups.

options.title: Keep Dynamic Inheritance
options.body: Maintain NULL `agent_id` as intentional default-agent inheritance, document it, and add tests proving migrated jobs run correctly without persisted ownership.

options.title: Require Manual Repair
options.body: Leave existing behavior and direct affected operators to an explicit doctor/SQL repair, accepting the support burden for upgraded fleets.

recommendation.title: Persist Configured Default
recommendation.body: Doctor/startup migration rewrites missing legacy ownership to the configured default agent and adds upgrade proof for non-main default-agent setups.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest feature-history signal for the cron SQLite and doctor migration boundary that owns this compatibility choice.
